items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: Bill Lewis, who is the program director and DJ there was just a huge supporter. He was the one pushing us really, to tour.

ctx.x: And your first performance of this music occurred when?

There was one quick performance we did down in Tampa for like it was called the “World’s Biggest Office Party.” But that was as Savatage, we played “Christmas Eve Sarajevo” for the first time. And then we also would play live on the radio. PLJ has, their pet charity is a childrens’ hospital, and I’m spacing on the name of it — I can’t remember — and every year they have live music with a lot of top acts, and they asked us to do that. So we were there ridiculously early in the morning playing. And we’d do…
Did the orchestra get larger, and the tech thing get larger every year?
